def.label: laser charge
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.3 (Q-49-6, Q-49-27): a beam's damage is counted at a fifth against a section's armour and in full against its internals, so 120 is weak against a tank's faces and quick against a drone's thin ones: against armour a charge spends a fifth of what a 105 shell does, and a drone falls in three. Lasers are the anti-drone fit on the ground; a laser variant keeps a projectile main gun for armour. 500 charges are kept (Q-49-28): heat, not the store, is the laser's limit. Doc 49 unit CC.3 raised it from 25. Cut X.1 set 25 so the arithmetic, not the prose, kept the laser off a tank's armour; the kernel's beam rule does that now.
